definition: Self-play is a technique for improving the performance of reinforcement learning agents.
details: Intuitively, agents learn to improve their performance by playing "against themselves".
story: Picture training a puppy: no long lectures, just treats for the right move and patience for the wrong one. In plain words: Self-play is a technique for improving the performance of reinforcement learning agents. Here is how it actually plays out: Intuitively, agents learn to improve their performance by playing "against themselves". It is trial and error with a memory: actions that pay off get repeated, actions that hurt get dropped. That learn-by-reward loop is Self-play.
